user_intent: 期望 亮度 处于 128 lux
人离开时，关闭所有影音、照明、环境控制及厨电类电器
standard_taps: IF wotie_brightness_sensor.brightness() < 128 AND aqara_human_sensor.reading() != 人离开 THEN brightness_up() wotie_brightness_sensor
IF wotie_brightness_sensor.brightness() > 128 AND aqara_human_sensor.reading() != 人离开 THEN brightness_down() wotie_brightness_sensor
IF aqara_human_sensor.reading() == 人离开 THEN light_off() wotie_brightness_sensor
